'''Lagdou Ruins''' (Japanese: {{hl|ラグドゥ遺跡|Ragudu iseki}} ''Lagdou Ruins'') is a location that appears in {{FE8}}, unlocked after completing [[Last Hope|Chapter&nbsp;19]]. The ruins consists of ten consecutive areas in which the player fights against various monsters. Five characters can be unlocked in the ruins during the [[Creature Campaign]]: [[Glen]], [[Hayden]], [[Valter]], [[Fado]], and [[Lyon]].

Throughout the ruins, there are chests with D-level items and [[gold]], which tends to make up for the broken weapons lost during battles. Various monsters throughout the ruins also have chances to drop valuable stat boosting items, gems, and even [[Master Seal]]s.
